title: DroneOptAI System Overview
content: DroneOptAI is an energy-optimized drone (UAV) delivery platform supporting multi-origin delivery networks. It leverages AI/ML to predict flight energy consumption, optimize flight routes, and support real-time operational decision-making.

title: System User Roles
content: The system defines 4 roles: (1) Customer - creates delivery orders and tracks shipments; (2) Operator - coordinates flight missions, approves schedules, and monitors drones; (3) Technician - maintains drones and manages batteries; (4) Admin - oversees system governance, revenue, and user management.

title: DroneOptAI Hub Network
content: DroneOptAI operates a network of transfer Hubs across Ho Chi Minh City. Each Hub serves as an origin and destination station for drones. Drones deliver packages from one Hub to another along AI-optimized routes. Each Hub is equipped with battery charging stations and drone landing pads.

title: Contact and Support
content: For support, customers can use the 24/7 AI chatbot inside the application. Complex technical issues are escalated to the support team. Typical response time is within 2 hours during business hours.
